advancement.netherman.enter_mansion.desc: Walk into the house that gold built
advancement.netherman.enter_maze.title: Mind the Walls
advancement.netherman.enter_maze.descrip: Something in here is counting your steps
advancement.netherman.tame_ghastly.title: The Crimson Bee
advancement.netherman.tame_ghastly.descr: It hums when you're near. It knows the way
advancement.netherman.azazel.title: The Chariot
advancement.netherman.azazel.description: Stand before the one who carried the sun
advancement.netherman.kill_azazel.title: The Throne Is Empty
advancement.netherman.kill_azazel.descri: You killed him. Half of you killed the other half
entity.netherman.azazel.surrender: Lay down your weapon, half-thing, and I may let you live.
entity.netherman.azazel.mercy: Good. You always did choose right, in the end.
entity.netherman.azazel.death: Forgive me, my lord... I could not hold your sky...
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line2: §6The half that fell soft, and forgot.
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line3: §6You came up through my quarries, through my gold.
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line4: §6I should take your eyes and keep your tongue.
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line5: §6But no. You came all this way.
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line6: §6So I will give you what I was never given:
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line7: §6a choice. Kneel, and be whole with me,
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line8: §6and we will take back the sky together.
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line9: §6That is my mercy. There is no other.
boss.netherman.azazel_human.line10: §6Approach, half of me, and bow at my feet.
tooltip.netherman.guide: Given to every pilgrim at the gate
tooltip.netherman.chance_totem.line1: Turns a killing blow aside, where you stand
tooltip.netherman.essence: [RMB] on a creature to bring it to the faith
tooltip.netherman.essence.line1: Nine pieces of faith make one
gui.netherman.quota.destroy: Burn a village, or kill %s/%s villagers
book.netherman.page1.line2: Given to every pilgrim at the gate.
book.netherman.page1.line4: Copied by a Preacher of the Sacred City.
book.netherman.page1.line7: He has waited. So can you.
book.netherman.page2.line2: Three courts, one above the other:
book.netherman.page2.line7: dig gold until they believe. The §4Manipulators
book.netherman.page2.line8: keep them at it. Kill a Manipulator and its
book.netherman.page2.line9: workers go free. You will be remembered for it.
book.netherman.page3.line1: §c§lTHE SACRED CITY:§f§l where the faithful live.
book.netherman.page3.line2: Walk softly. Two here will serve you:
book.netherman.page3.line4: §cThe Doctor§f§l - mends the faithful, for a price
book.netherman.page3.line6: and leaves its blessings where they are.
book.netherman.page3.line7: §4§lTHE LAIR:§f§l the end of the road.
book.netherman.page3.line8: What waits there is not for pilgrims.
book.netherman.page4.line3: Pipes in the hills. The ground cracks beneath them.
book.netherman.page4.line4: A compass, a pillar, a head. Read what's inside.
book.netherman.page4.line5: A maze. Be careful. Look up.
book.netherman.page4.line6: And past all of it: God.
book.netherman.page4.line7: Two roads to him. The faithful road takes three days.
book.netherman.page5.line2: builds its hive in crimson stems,
book.netherman.page5.line5: and always knows the way home.
book.netherman.page6.line3: Turns a killing blow aside, once, where you stand.
book.netherman.page6.line5: Bends the will, pulls the body,
book.netherman.page6.line6: and calls the dead to serve.
